nodes.title: KSampler settings
widgets_values:
You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.
|   | Qwen | Comfy |
|--------|---------|------------|
| Steps  | 40      | 20         |
| CFG    | 4.0     | 4.0       |

nodes.title: Prompt - Stage 1 - ROUGH
widgets_values: Top-down phone snapshot looking into an open black rubber rock-tumbler barrel on a cluttered, dusty garage workbench. Inside, among ordinary rough grey rocks, sits the object from image 1, shrunk to the size of a walnut and turned into rough stone: its shape, colours and patterns are still recognisable, but the surface is raw, matte, chipped and dusty, with sharp broken corners. Grey rock dust on the scuffed, worn rubber rim and on the rocks. Unglamorous real phone snapshot: one overhead shop light with natural falloff so the edges of the frame go dim, imperfect slightly tilted off-centre framing, true-to-life muted colour, ordinary phone exposure, no HDR, no glow, no vignette effect. The barrel rim, the rocks and the workbench are bare: no tape, no labels, no stickers, no handwriting, no text, no captions anywhere in the image; if image 1 shows any tape or writing, remove it. Style: an unedited real photograph, not a render: no CGI render look, no plastic skin or plastic surfaces, no cartoon, no illustration, no text, no glowing edges, no oversaturation.

nodes.title: Prompt - Stage 2 - COARSE 60/90
widgets_values: Same top-down phone snapshot into the same open rock-tumbler barrel as image 1, opened one week later mid-cycle. The stone made from the object is now rounded by coarse 60/90 grit: corners gone, softer silhouette, smeared with thick wet grey grit slurry like runny cement that pools in the bottom of the barrel, streaks the wet black rubber walls and drips over the rim. Under the slurry, the colours and motifs of the object in image 2 show only as faint, dull bands inside the stone. Same rocks, same workbench. Unglamorous real phone snapshot: one overhead shop light with natural falloff so the edges of the frame go dim, imperfect slightly tilted off-centre framing, true-to-life muted colour, ordinary phone exposure, no HDR, no glow, no vignette effect. The barrel rim, the rocks and the workbench are bare: no tape, no labels, no stickers, no handwriting, no text, no captions anywhere in the image; if image 1 shows any tape or writing, remove it. Style: an unedited real photograph, not a render: no CGI render look, no plastic skin or plastic surfaces, no cartoon, no illustration, no text, no glowing edges, no oversaturation.

nodes.title: Prompt - Stage 3 - FINE 500
widgets_values: Same top-down phone snapshot into the same open rock-tumbler barrel as image 1, rinsed after fine 500 grit: wet black rubber beaded with water, a thin film of pale grey residue and leftover grit in the seams. The stone is now a smooth, satin-matte, egg-shaped pebble with a couple of tiny pits. Concentric agate-like bands run through it, and the bands are made of the object in image 2: its colours, motifs and patterns wrap around the stone in layers, slightly muted like real stone. Unglamorous real phone snapshot: one overhead shop light with natural falloff so the edges of the frame go dim, imperfect slightly tilted off-centre framing, true-to-life muted colour, ordinary phone exposure, no HDR, no glow, no vignette effect. The barrel rim, the rocks and the workbench are bare: no tape, no labels, no stickers, no handwriting, no text, no captions anywhere in the image; if image 1 shows any tape or writing, remove it. Style: an unedited real photograph, not a render: no CGI render look, no plastic skin or plastic surfaces, no cartoon, no illustration, no text, no glowing edges, no oversaturation.

nodes.title: Prompt - Stage 4 - POLISH
widgets_values: The finished tumbled stone from image 1, held on an ordinary open palm just above the same open rock-tumbler barrel, phone snapshot. Real polish, not a gem render: a glossy surface with one small soft reflection of the shop light, faint scratches and a tiny pit, grit dust in the creases of the hand, natural skin with pores, lines and a little dirt under the nails. Inside the semi-translucent stone, agate banding made of the object from image 2: its colours, motifs and patterns compressed into concentric geological layers, colours slightly muted like real agate. Phone close-up, focus a little soft at the edges, no sparkle. Unglamorous real phone snapshot: one overhead shop light with natural falloff so the edges of the frame go dim, imperfect slightly tilted off-centre framing, true-to-life muted colour, ordinary phone exposure, no HDR, no glow, no vignette effect. The barrel rim, the rocks and the workbench are bare: no tape, no labels, no stickers, no handwriting, no text, no captions anywhere in the image; if image 1 shows any tape or writing, remove it. Style: an unedited real photograph, not a render: no CGI render look, no plastic skin or plastic surfaces, no cartoon, no illustration, no text, no glowing edges, no oversaturation.

nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
# Grit Happens: 4-stage grit carousel
Load your object (inputs/object_patch_box.png = CC0 Met enamel patch box). One run = four chained Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 stages:
ROUGH -> COARSE 60/90 -> FINE 500 -> POLISH. Each stage takes the previous stage as image 1 and the ORIGINAL object as image 2,
so the banding keeps the object's colors and motifs. Four SaveImage nodes = the four carousel slides.
Optional reveal video: save 01_rough and 04_polish into ComfyUI/input as grit_stage1.png / grit_stage4.png and run grit-happens-reveal.json.
Lightning 4-step ON, seed fixed (20261103). LoRA slot: bypassed LoraLoader inside the shared subgraph. First real run 2026-11-02: the model garbled taped stage labels, so all in-image text was removed from the prompts afterwards (add stage captions in post). Shared anti-slop negative prompt is linked to every stage (only takes effect when CFG > 1, i.e. Lightning OFF).
